fields.label: Restaurant Order
fields.description: The Hub's own order UUID, not a Frappe Link — orders are created and live only on the Hub (CLAUDE.md rule 4) and are never individually mirrored into Frappe, same convention as Void Log/KOT's own restaurant_order field.

fields.label: Original Sales Invoice
fields.description: Ticket P4-16: the already-submitted, already-paid invoice this refund reverses part or all of. A refund can only be pushed once this invoice has itself finished syncing (has a real name) — the sync-worker's own push-refunds.ts retries until then.

fields.label: Credit Note
fields.description: The real, submitted return Sales Invoice (is_return=1, return_against=Original Sales Invoice) this refund created — Tech Architecture §8's 'a void creates a linked reversing entry; numbers are never reused or deleted.'

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Paise. Never more than the amount paid on that bill minus any earlier refunds against it (Validation & Conventions §3) — enforced Hub-side before this is ever pushed.

fields.label: Approved By
fields.description: A different supervisor/owner-manager who approved it with their own PIN — never the same session as requested_by (ticket P4-16 reuses P2-04's own Void Log maker-checker convention, since no separate policy is stated for a post-payment refund).

fields.label: Correction Of
fields.description: Ticket P3-29: this record never edits or deletes the original - it is a NEW entry that points back at it.
